subject: Global pay slab rewrite for offers — decision request
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, markus.klein@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Global pay slab rewrite for offers — decision request

Team —

Summary: attached is a proposed rewrite of the global pay slabs and a simplified offer matrix to remove redundant midpoints and align geo tiers (US / EU / APAC) against the Mercer benchmarks. This is intended to: 1) reduce offer variance across regions, 2) simplify recruiter guidance, and 3) free up marginal headroom for senior IC offers in critical roles.

Key changes in the attached XLS:
- New slab names (Tier A / B / C) mapped to prior L4–L7 buckets
- Geo multipliers baked into band floor/ceiling (APAC index lowered by -8%, EU index at -3%, US baseline)
- New senior IC guardrails: ability to stretch to +12% above midpoint with VP approval

Asks:
- Vivek: confirm approval for the senior IC guardrail for infra and runtime roles (this will affect two open req offers).
- Laura: sign-off on the geo multipliers and recruiter-facing guidance (last sheet).
- Markus: confirm we have budget headroom for the proposed band compression (two headcount moves: reallocate 0.2 FTE from bench to hiring pool).

Attachments: 2026_Q2_pay_slabs_v3.xlsx (main), Mercer_Global_Benchmarks_Q2_2026.pdf (summary) — Mercer sent the PDF yesterday and allowed redistribution.

Timeline: need final sign-off by EOD Friday 06/19 to hit recruiting SLA for the two high-priority offers.

Notes: I included proposed language for offer letters in the recruiter guidance tab; we can keep market-adjustment lines optional.

Thanks,
Olga
Olga Petrov
Head of Sales Ops (acting)
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: 2026_Q2_pay_slabs_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet, 72KB)
Attachment: Mercer_Global_Benchmarks_Q2_2026.pdf (pdf, 340KB)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: markus.klein@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Global pay slab rewrite for offers — decision request

Thanks, Olga — quick thoughts inline.

On Thu, 18 Jun 2026 at 09:12 AM Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> Summary: attached is a proposed rewrite...

A few operational notes:
- Senior IC guardrail (+12% above midpoint) — I support conditional approval but request we add a one-line justification template that recruiters must attach to the offer doc (role-critical rationale + peer comp check). This prevents ad-hoc outsized offers.
- Geo multipliers look reasonable, but I asked Mercer for a short note on sample sizes for APAC (we need to be sure the -8% isn't driven by two ill-fitting companies).
- For the two open infra reqs, I can authorize stretching to +8% immediately; +12% needs either Laura or my explicit written sign-off per current approvals matrix.

Make the justification template a single checkbox + freeform in Workday; I'll loop with HR ops if Laura signs off.

Vivek
VP, Product
Redwood Inference

--
Quoted attachment: Mercer note requested (will forward when received)

From: Mercer Compensation <benchmarks@mercer.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 12:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Global pay slab rewrite for offers — Mercer benchmark summary (Q2 2026)

Olga, Vivek, Laura —

Attached is the Mercer Q2 2026 summary you requested. Key highlights relevant to Redwood:
- APAC sample sizes are small in several niche infra roles (n < 25); recommended to rely on blended regional benchmarks rather than single-market medians.
- EU medians are within -2 to -4% of US equivalents for cloud/platform engineering roles; large variance at senior levels.
- Suggested approach: use blended benchmark + 5th/95th percentiles for guardrails at senior levels.

See attached PDF: Mercer_Global_Benchmarks_Q2_2026.pdf

Regards,
Claire Mendes
Client Partner, Global Rewards
Mercer Compensation
benchmarks@mercer.com

--
Attachment: Mercer_Global_Benchmarks_Q2_2026.pdf (pdf, 340KB)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: markus.klein@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Global pay slab rewrite for offers — decision request

Thanks everyone — I reviewed the spreadsheet and Mercer's summary.

Decision: APPROVED with two edits (please update XLS and circulate final version):
1) Senior IC guardrail remains at +12% but requires a one-paragraph written justification attached to the offer and sign-off from the hiring manager + VP (Vivek). Recruiters must use the template Olga put on the last sheet.
2) For APAC hires where Mercer sample size < 25, use blended APAC/EU benchmark and flag the offer in Workday as "market-adjusted" for audit tracking.

Markus: proceed to reallocate the 0.2 FTE as proposed and update headcount tracker.
Olga: please publish final recruiter guidance and add a brief note to the candidate-facing offer approvals: "offers align to regional market practice" (non-specific).

I'll inform People Ops to expect two near-term offers to queue for approval. If recruiters hit +12% threshold, escalate to me and copy Vivek.

Laura
Head of People Ops
Redwood Inference

--
